data.one_liner: Easily use the Heroicons set in your Flutter app as SVG files.
data.what_it_does: It renders Heroicons inside your Flutter application as SVG images using widgets like HeroIcon. It supports different styles such as outline and solid, and offers global styling via HeroIconTheme.
use_when: You want to use the official Heroicons set in your Flutter application.
You need icons that can be rendered dynamically as SVGs with customizable colors and sizes.
avoid_when: You need a general-purpose icon package that is not limited to Heroicons.
You prefer using standard Material or Cupertino icon fonts instead of SVG-based icon sets.
strengths: Provides direct support for Heroicons with enum-based icon selection.
Supports global icon styling using HeroIconTheme.
Automatically handles semantic labels and icon sizing.
weaknesses: Limited exclusively to the Heroicons icon set.
Depends on SVG rendering which may have performance overhead compared to font icons if used in massive quantities.
data.setup_notes: Run `flutter pub add heroicons` to add the package.

alternatives.name: flutter_svg
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer handling and rendering raw SVG files or custom icons directly without being locked into a specific pre-packaged icon set wrapper.
